# PinPoint Tech

> מעבדת מחשבים ברמת גן (computer & laptop repair lab in Ramat Gan, Israel).

PinPoint Tech repairs desktop computers and laptops, cleans and maintains hardware
(including thermal paste replacement and temperature checks), builds custom PCs to
order, upgrades hardware, and installs/updates Windows 11/10 and BIOS.

- Location: Ramat Gan, Israel
- Contact: WhatsApp / phone, 054-688-0303
- Website: https://pinpoint-tech.github.io/pinpoint-tech/

Customers can drop off their device at the lab or request a visit. Pricing is
positioned as affordable ("במחיר ששווה לכל כיס" — a price that's worth every penny).
